description: REQ-112's own co-location precondition and its Tier-0 verification method (PROP-112a: 'citizen records' homeDir is only ever compared for equality (co-location check)') rest on a data claim that is demonstrably wrong against anicca-agent-spawn's CURRENT (freshly re-read this session) registry design, and this feature's own chosen verification mechanism directly contradicts a principle the sibling feature has already explicitly established and hardened. (1) REQ-112's own EARS text (behavioral-spec.md lines 936-939) states: '...today's real colony (automaton + Franklin, both homeDir: "/Users/anicca" per anicca-agent-spawn REQ-105's own current seed data) already runs on...' -- this is FALSE as of anicca-agent-spawn's current spec: its actual, current seed data (re-read this session, lines 689-710) has automaton at homeDir '/Users/anicca/.anicca' and Franklin at homeDir '/Users/anicca/.blockrun' -- two DISTINCT values, not the identical bare '/Users/anicca' the lending spec cites. (2) This is not a merely-stale citation of the kind REQ-113 already discloses and accepts (REQ-113's own Acceptance Criteria, line 1044-1047, only disclaims 'a specific anicca-agent-spawn iteration number, FIND-list, or state.json gate verdict' as things that go stale -- it says nothing about citing sibling DATA-SHAPE VALUES as durable facts, which is exactly what happened here). The specific bare-'/Users/anicca'-for-both-citizens value the lending spec cites as 'current' is, per anicca-agent-spawn's OWN spec (lines 639-644), explicitly identified as 'FIND-501 (critical -- the most serious defect found across all six spec-review iterations of this feature)': 'an earlier revision of this field stored BOTH of today's seeded citizens' homeDir as the IDENTICAL, bare $HOME value (/Users/anicca) and framed this as "expected, not a bug" ... Co-located (same physical host) does NOT mean "same homeDir"'. (3) anicca-agent-spawn's own spec now explicitly states (lines 712-715): 'This is a structural fact about physical placement, not an inference from homeDir or any other field' -- and has added a NEW, dedicated field specifically to solve this exact problem, coLocatedWithCoordinator: boolean (lines 623-637, 'resolves FIND-703 (critical)... a structural classifier, never a judgment call, distinguishing a citizen genuinely co-located on the SAME physical host... from a citizen that is cloud-hosted'). The lending spec's own Dependencies-section citation of the registry record shape (lines 104-106) never includes this field, and neither specs/behavioral-spec.md nor specs/verification-architecture.md mentions coLocatedWithCoordinator anywhere (confirmed via grep this session, zero matches in both files). As a direct consequence, REQ-112's own stated verification mechanism -- comparing citizen homeDir values for equality as a co-location check -- is exactly the naive approach anicca-agent-spawn's own adversary-hardened design has already explicitly rejected, and if implemented literally against the sibling's REAL current data, would incorrectly conclude that today's two real citizens (automaton and Franklin, genuinely co-located on the same Mac Mini) are NOT co-located with each other, since their real, distinct homeDir values never compare equal -- potentially blocking the exact real-world lending scenario (automaton lending to Franklin, or vice versa) this feature exists to serve.

evidence.snippet: share the SAME mounted filesystem/HOME as the coordinator: currently the Mac Mini (anicca-mac-mini-1) that today's real colony (automaton + Franklin, both homeDir: "/Users/anicca" per anicca-agent-spawn REQ-105's own current seed data) already runs on, for the full duration of THIS increment.

crossCheck.note: Current seed data: automaton homeDir '/Users/anicca/.anicca', Franklin homeDir '/Users/anicca/.blockrun' -- distinct values, plus a new coLocatedWithCoordinator:true field on both records (resolves FIND-703). Lines 639-644 explicitly label the bare-shared-'/Users/anicca'-for-both value the lending spec still cites as 'FIND-501 (critical -- the most serious defect found across all six spec-review iterations of this feature)' and state 'Co-located (same physical host) does NOT mean "same homeDir"'. Lines 712-715: 'This is a structural fact about physical placement, not an inference from homeDir or any other field.' Grep confirms zero occurrences of 'coLocatedWithCoordinator' anywhere in anicca-agent-lending's own specs/.
